title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Jail Born
A night at the beach in his brother's truck sends a repeat offender back to jail; a Christmas morning hold-up leaves a young man dead and four people in jail with serious charges.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Taking a Hostage
At the Penitentiary of New Mexico, officers are outnumbered, and the inmates are unpredictable, especially in Level 6, the maximum-security facility; it's where the deputy warden says "the worst of the worst" are housed.

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Bad Rep
A man accused of possessing child porn tries to salvage his relationship with his daughter and her children; deputies contend with an inmate on a mission.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E6 — Checkmate
The tenth floor of Cuyahoga County Correction Center contains the Special Response Team, or SERT, a tactical unit trained in the use of riot gear, non-lethal weapons and controlling high-risk inmates.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — For Better or Worse
Alcohol is not allowed inside Indiana State Prison; that doesn't stop the inmates from making it, or correctional officers from confiscating it; in past years, the most common forms of contraband were drugs or tobacco; today it's cell phones.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Dirt Roads and Trouble
A young woman finds love in the jail's one co-ed housing unit; another inmate, charged with a spree of armed robberies, now comes under investigation inside the jail; a father speaks for his son, who if found guilty, could face the death penalty.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Bad Good Friday
A murderous shooting spree erupts on a major religious holiday; a new inmate catches the jail staff's attention; a father of five receives haunting news from home.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Brother Against Brother
The arrest of two brothers in the murders of four women.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Miss Fortune
A troubled young inmate, recently sentenced to prison, attempts to make a final impression on staff; a young woman who gave birth in the jail watches her baby grow up without her.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Next of Kin
The jail responds with force after an officer is assaulted and inmates attempt escape; an 18-year-old shoots her father to death then finds a surrogate mother on the inside.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — 'Til Death Do Us Part
Holman houses over 170 men who have been sentenced to death and are awaiting execution, as well as 360 who are serving life sentences without parole; all are living with the inevitable: that their only chance of getting out will be inside a coffin.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Citizen's Arrest
A convicted thief continues his stealing ways inside the jail; a former law enforcement officer turned meth addict serves time with and grows closer to her dealer; a man gets arrested for allegedly threatening the sheriff.

title: Lockup: Pendleton: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Inside Pendleton Juvenile
The inmates at Indiana's Pendleton Juvenile Correctional Facility aren't sentenced in terms of years; they get out when they achieve certain goals, no matter how long that takes.
